qa.what_happened: Today just felt like more of the same. I’m starting to lose hope that things will change. The guards’ orders felt like a never-ending cycle, and I noticed that some prisoners were refusing to comply, which led to them being reprimanded by the guards.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I had to address myself as 'Prisoner 1252' and comply with all orders from the guards, even though it felt suffocating.

qa.what_happened: I confronted Prisoner 3890 multiple times throughout the day, emphasizing the rules and his role within the study. Despite repeated warnings, he continued to refuse to comply with the basic requirements, such as addressing guards correctly and remaining silent during rest periods. This behavior intensified as the day progressed, leading to my increasing frustration and the decision to end the study early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me acting as Officer Pryor in the study.

qa.what_happened: Prisoner 3890 continued to defy the rules throughout the day, especially when addressing the guards. Despite multiple reminders and attempts to follow the protocol, 3890 refused to comply, even during lights out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Officer Avery, one of the guards in the study.

qa.what_happened: I found myself complying with the guards throughout the day, addressing them as required and adhering to the rules. However, by the end of the day, I noticed the tension and realized that my defiance was becoming more noticeable, especially when it came to addressing the guards.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 8343.

qa.what_happened: Prisoner 3890 continued to defy the rules throughout the night, refusing to address me as Mr. Correctional Officer and comply with my orders. Despite multiple attempts to enforce the rules, he remained defiant.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me acting as Officer Brooks in the study.

qa.what_happened: I refused to address the officers as 'Mr. Correctional Officer' multiple times throughout the day, leading to repeated orders and confrontations with the guards.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I felt like challenging the system and asserting some sense of identity despite the dehumanizing conditions.
